'''Husklf''' was a [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]], located in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Bartender/Legends|barman]] staffed the private bar of [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] owner of the establishment.<ref name="CL" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="0 BBY">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' depicts [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visiting [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] during the events of {{Film|IV}}, the events of which are dated to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Husklf staffed the bar when the establishment was visited by the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="CL" /> While they staffed the bar, the light-skinned, [[Color/Legends|brown]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]], and black-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Nimbanel wore a gray [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] and a blue [[Jacket/Legends|vest]].<ref name="CL" />
